issues.issue: Did the RPD err in analysing whether the claim falls under section 96?
issues.applicant_position: RPD failed to analyse the claim under section 96 on imputed political opinion.
issues.result_text: RPD did analyse the claim under s.96; its credibility conclusion applies to both ss.96 and 97, so the criticism is unfounded.

issues.issue: Did the RPD breach natural justice by disregarding affidavits and other evidence without giving reasons?
issues.applicant_position: RPD disregarded much evidence, including affidavits from his brother, friend, father and sarpanch, without reasons.
issues.result_text: RPD erred significantly in disregarding evidence without sufficient reasons; matter referred to a differently constituted panel.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in its credibility assessment?
issues.applicant_position: Contradictions were minor and the delay in seeking protection was not determinative.
issues.result_text: No need to address the minor contradictions and delay given the natural justice finding; new panel will assess credibility.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err by not analysing an internal flight alternative?
issues.applicant_position: RPD erred in failing to analyse the internal flight alternative.
issues.result_text: RPD did not err in omitting an IFA analysis because it found the appellant not credible.
